hero.title: Emberfall
hero.subtitle: Descend a collapsing volcano; every death reshapes the mountain.

items.title: Momentum combat
items.body: Dashing through lava builds heat you spend on signature moves.

items.title: The mountain bites back
items.body: Linger too long and eruptions seal off the safe routes.

items.title: Persistent forge
items.body: Ore banked between runs unlocks permanent gear at the hub.

ol: Drop into a procedurally carved cavern layer.
Fight downward, banking ore at each checkpoint shrine.
Beat the layer boss or extract before the next eruption.

labeled.label: North star
labeled.value: Fast in the hand, heavy in the chest — speed should feel earned, never safe.
